title: More than ordinary sleep
hook: A winter state can alter several body processes.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The two bar heights are a qualitative model of a lower metabolic state, not animal measurements. During deep torpor some hibernators reduce metabolic rate and body temperature, but processes continue and patterns vary among species.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: During deep torpor in some hibernating mammals, which change can occur relative to an active state?
